{{Top|leg}}
The '''Broken Skull''' was a group of gangsters that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They offered their services as suppliers and mercenaries at a cheap rate to anyone who could eliminate their rivals.
